creator: opichillc
title: PSA: rotate every API key you have used with AI coding tools -- rotate if supported, otherwise create a new key, deploy it, verify, then delete the old one
claims: With AI coding tools there is a bigger chance than with human developers that keys get exposed somewhere you don't know about
Takes 5 minutes for a few keys, ~30 minutes for many; prevents someone running up charges on your accounts
how_to_steps: Inventory all API keys your projects use
Go to each provider; rotate the key if a rotate option exists
If not: create a new key, put it in the app, confirm it works, then disable/delete the old key
cta: Like, follow, share with anyone using API keys

relevance.why: Cheap hygiene that matters more for solo AI-assisted builders who paste keys into chats and agents; no new tool, just a habit.

implement_score.why: Do it once now (30 min), then calendar a quarterly rotation; pair with the gitleaks step and keep keys in env/secret managers. Zero cost.

verify: Which of Haji's providers support in-place rotation vs create-then-delete (Stripe, Anthropic, OpenAI, Supabase, Vercel)
Whether any keys have ever been pasted into Claude/ChatGPT chats or committed (run gitleaks on history first)

gap.what: Adds a routine (periodic key rotation with the create -> deploy -> verify -> delete order). Liked set mentioned exposed secrets as a gap but not rotation practice.
